sakectl(1) General Commands Manual sakectl(1)

NAME

sakectl - Manage a running instance of the sake IRC bouncer

SYNOPSIS

sakectl [options...] <command...>

DESCRIPTION

sakectl sends a BouncerServ command to a running sake instance. See the IRC SERVICE section in sake(1) for more information.

sakectl requires a listen unix+admin:// directive in the sake configuration file. sakectl needs to be run with write permissions on the sake admin socket.

OPTIONS

-h, -help

Show help message and quit.

-config <path>

Path to the config file. If unset, the default config file path is used, if any.
